title: 2 ETFs To Play The Lumber Shortage
description:
Retail investors can make money in the commodities markets. Lumber is a prime example right now.
The soaring prices of lumber have become mainstream news. The price per thousand board feet has moved from $320 to $1,675 over the past year, the highest it has ever been.

title: Severe Weather Hits Graphic Packaging's Operations, Cuts Outlook
description: Graphic Packaging Holding reported that severe weather and an electrical substation failure disrupted its operations, leading the company to lower its Q3 2024 adjusted EBITDA outlook and expect full-year 2024 results to be below the midpoint of its previous forecasts.

description: Invesco Canada announced the November 2024 cash distributions for its exchange-traded funds (ETFs). Unitholders will receive the distributions on December 6, 2024.
